sahihInternational: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
yusufAli: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.

arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
sahihInternational: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
yusufAli: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
urdu: اور نوجوان خدمت گار (جو ایسے ہوں گے) جیسے چھپائے ہوئے موتی ان کے آس پاس پھریں گے
جیسے (حفاظت سے) تہہ کئے ہوئے (آب دار) موتی
